new_theorems.note: REVISED after review: proves no single admissible configuration attains U_3(eta) exactly. Does NOT prove C_3,ind^P(eta) < U_3(eta) as a strict supremum inequality -- that was an overclaim in the first version (non-attainment does not imply a strict sup gap; a sup can be approached without being attained). The strict-gap question is tracked separately as OPEN_V5_K3_STRICT_SUPREMUM_GAP. Does not produce a replacement tightened value either way.

current_state_addendum_2026_08_09.statement: Every fixed finite typed tree admits evaluation-preserving projector-invariant support compression with dim(W_tau) <= 2*(leaf_count_tau + 2*node_count_tau) per type; binary k=3 has bound 20, or 22 with proper-projector padding.
current_state_addendum_2026_08_09.global_corollary: For the declared independent-law binary k=3 chain and branching classes, C_3,ind^P(eta) < U_3(eta) for 0 < eta <= 1 by finite support compression, compactness, and M10 non-attainment; eta=1 uses the endpoint addendum.
limitations: The exact C_3^P(eta) and an explicit quantitative gap remain open; the strict endpoint gap is proved but its exact constant is not.
No dimension/rank bound uniform over unbounded tree size or arity is claimed.
Novelty and independent human review remain pending.

new_open_items_from_review.statement: Whether C_3,ind^P(eta) < U_3(eta) strictly, or the supremum equals U_3(eta) approached-but-unattained, is open. Route A: compactness argument (blocked on open dimension/rank reduction). Route B: explicit quantitative gap E_proj <= U_3(eta)-delta(eta) (stronger, unconditional, not attempted).

followup_addendum_m13_2026_08_09.statement: For the independent-law ordered binary k=3 chain, C_3,ind,chain^P(eta) <= W_3(eta), where W_3=sqrt(4-3 eta^2) for eta<=sqrt(2/3) and W_3=2/(sqrt(3) eta) above; W_3<U_3 on 0<eta<=1.
limitations: Chain only; branching, W_3 sharpness, exact C_3, novelty, and independent human review remain open.

followup_addendum_m14_2026_08_09.statement: For the independent-law ordered binary k=3 chain, C_3,ind,chain^P(eta)=W_3(eta) for every 0<eta<=1; a dimension-two rank-one witness attains the M13 envelope.
limitations: Branching envelope/constant, same-law/gated subclasses, arbitrary-tree sharpness, novelty, and independent human review remain open.

followup_addendum_m15_2026_08_09.statement: For the independent-law ordered binary k=3 branching tree, C_3,ind,branch^P(eta)=W_3(eta) for every 0<eta<=1; nuclear/operator-norm duality supplies the upper bound and a dimension-two polar-factor witness attains it.
limitations: Same-law/gated subclasses, arbitrary-tree sharpness, novelty, and independent human review remain open.

followup_addendum_m18_2026_08_09.statement: For every fixed finite ordered full-binary tree T with k internal vertices, the independent-law projected-root constant satisfies lim_{eta downarrow 0} C_{T,ind}^P(eta)=k-1; the explicit two-dimensional real-plane witness (identified with C) has E_proj=|sin((k-1) arcsin(eta))|.
limitations: Asymptotic eta downarrow 0 only; fixed-eta equality, higher arity, same-law/gated variants, growing-tree uniformity, novelty, and independent human review remain open.

followup_addendum_m19_2026_08_09.statement: For every fixed finite ordered rooted tree T with all internal arities at least two, the independent-law projected-root constant satisfies lim_{eta downarrow 0} C_{T,ind}^P(eta)=k(T)-1; the real-plane witness has E_proj=|sin((k-1) arcsin(eta))|.
limitations: Asymptotic eta downarrow 0 and fixed finite trees only; fixed-eta equality, same-law/gated sharpness, growing-tree uniformity, novelty, and independent human review remain open.

followup_addendum_m20_2026_08_09.statement: For every finite ordered rooted tree T with exactly three internal vertices and all internal arities at least two, the independent-law projected-root constant is C_{T,ind}^P(eta)=W_3(eta) for every 0<eta<=1. Freezing unit leaf slots reduces the internal-child skeleton to M14's chain or M15's branching class, and unit e0 gates embed the matching witness.
limitations: Same-law/gated variants, fixed-eta independent-law trees with k>=4, growing-tree uniformity, novelty, and independent human review remain open.

followup_addendum_m21_2026_08_09.statement: For binary k=3 chain and branching classes with one repeated bilinear law, arbitrary unit projected leaves, and finite projector rank, orthogonal leaf tags select an orthogonal direct-sum block that simulates M14 or M15. The tagged same-law constant is W_3(eta) for every 0<eta<=1.
limitations: Rank-one/common-leaf same-law restrictions, gated/variable-gate subclasses, fixed-eta independent-law trees with k>=4, growing-tree uniformity, novelty, and independent human review remain open.

followup_addendum_m22_2026_08_09.statement: For the strict binary k=3 chain with one repeated gated rotation, common unit projected leaf e0, and rank-one projector span(e0), the class constant equals W_3(eta)=2/(sqrt(3) eta) for sqrt(2/3)<=eta<=1. The rotation leakage is fixed at sqrt(2/3), which is admissible throughout the regime.
limitations: The low-eta rank-one/common-leaf same-law chain, rank-one/common-leaf branching, broader gated/shared-law variants, fixed-eta independent-law trees with k>=4, growing-tree uniformity, novelty, and independent human review remain open.

followup_addendum_m23_2026_08_09.statement: For the strict binary k=3 chain with one repeated real bilinear law, common unit projected leaf e0, and rank-one projector span(e0), the projected error is exactly |<e0,A^3 e0>-<e0,A e0>^3| for A(x)=mu(x,e0). Conversely every finite-dimensional contraction A is realized by the gated repeated law mu_A(x,y)=A x <e0,y>, so the remaining class extremum is exactly the corresponding contraction-operator supremum after normalization.
limitations: The reduction does not evaluate the low-eta supremum; rank-one/common-leaf branching, broader same-law/gated variants, fixed-eta independent-law trees with k>=4, novelty, and independent human review remain open.

current_state_correction_2026_08_09.current_statement: For every finite ordered k=3 arity profile in the declared independent-law projected-root class, M20 gives the exact normalized constant W_3(eta) for every 0<eta<=1, with W_3=sqrt(4-3 eta^2) below sqrt(2/3) and W_3=2/(sqrt(3) eta) above.
current_state_correction_2026_08_09.k2_class_a_correction: The declared finite-dimensional real binary k=2 class-level constant is C_{2,A}^P(eta)=1 for 0<eta<=1, by the universal upper bound and the embedded repeated-law witness.
current_state_correction_2026_08_09.m16_binary_k3_corollary: Because the M14/M15 independent-law convention freely selects each node law with no sharing constraint, their exact W_3 values also close the arbitrary-node-law binary k=3 chain and branching class.
current_state_correction_2026_08_09.m17_k2_gated_contraction: For the explicitly defined repeated gated law mu_A(x,y)=A*x*<e0,y> with a fixed gate and active planar contraction, the exact normalized k=2 constant is 1; the canonical rotation's eta^2 value is due to its additional orthogonality constraint.
